decision.summary: No new action: the daily 78k reach remains the right live expression of the corrective rebound, and there is no cleaner second position to add.
decision.rationale: Binance remains bullish short term with expanding open interest and price still trading close to the 24h high, so the existing 78k reach daily continues to be the correct live position. It is not near take-profit and not near exceptional invalidation. Re-adding is not allowed because the position is already at the full early-stage $1 live cash cap. The next bullish daily at 79k is materially farther and only around 15%, while the bearish dailies and weekly dips remain badly misaligned with current execution reality. With no clean weekly frontier and no justified second daily, the disciplined move is to hold.
